messages:
Anna (Partnerships): thinking about a new private-offer shape to drive meter-to-commit conversions. low-friction for customers who want BYOH hardware credits + a graduated discount on renewals. high level: staged commitments with increasing discounts if they hit usage bands.
Mike (Marketplace): sounds interesting — can you sketch the stages?
Anna (Partnerships): short version: 3 stages - onboarding (month 0-3) with usage credits, growth (3-9) with mid-tier discount, stable (9-24) with full committed discount + renewal smoothing.
Jon (Sales Ops): concrete asks: how does proration work if they convert mid-cycle? and do we allow partial BYOH credits applied to monthly invoices?
Anna (Partnerships): proration: convert immediately, credit applied pro-rata for remaining term. BYOH credit: one-time hardware credit token that reduces invoice until exhausted, visible in console.
Tara (Legal): we need anti-abuse language around synthetic usage (eg replaying requests to hit bands). also check marketplace terms for credit tokens and expiration windows.
Priya (SI): timeline question — SI integrations need a predictable SKU mapping. can we expose a dedicated partner-SKU so our integrators can invoice and push consumption proofs?
Anna (Partnerships): yes — plan is partner-SKU + partner report webhook. That lets SI surface usage for conversion triggers.
marketplace-bot: private offer draft created: https://marketplace.example/offer/PO-1735 (internal only) :eyes:
Mike (Marketplace): love the partner-SKU idea. for renewals, propose a graduated taper: discount 15% (entry), 22% (growth), 30% (stable). If usage drops below floor at renewal, we offer a 30-day grace band before reprice.
Jon (Sales Ops): ok on taper numbers, but need churn protection clause. suggest auto-rollback to a floor rate if <70% of committed usage over 2 consecutive months post-renewal.
Tara (Legal): we'll draft the grace-band language and the anti-avoidance clause. flag: make expiration for BYOH credits 12 months from grant.
Priya (SI): co-marketing ask — can we get a joint announcement template and a 60-day enablement window for partners to prep?
Anna (Partnerships): yes. i'll add an enablement checklist and a 60-day co-marketing slot.
Mike (Marketplace): next steps: 1) legal drafts terms 2) product config for partner-SKU & credit tokens 3) ops to implement pro-rata credit math 4) partnership playbook + announcement template.
Anna (Partnerships): assigning: @Tara (legal) leads terms, @Jon (Sales Ops) owns proration rules, @Mike (Marketplace) owns partner-SKU + console display, @Priya (SI) coordinate enablement. I'll open a shared doc and schedule a 30-min sync Friday. :calendar:
Jon (Sales Ops): +1. please drop the doc link here when ready.
Anna (Partnerships): will do, thanks everyone. :partyparrot:
